debug.description: Enable verbose debugging output to log for diagnostics.

log_file.description: Absolute path to the main log file.

log_max_size.description: Maximum size (in MB) of the log file before rotation.

log_retention.description: Number of rotated log files to keep.

num_threads.description: Number of worker threads to handle client requests.

bind_address.description: IP address or hostname to bind metadata services to.

metadata_port.description: Port number for metadata protocol communication.

enable_replication.description: Enable asynchronous replication of metadata between gfsd instances.

replication_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for metadata replication operations.

items.description: Hostname or IP of a GFM master server.

master_hosts.description: List of GFM master servers for metadata coordination.

items.description: Hostname or IP of a GFM server for load-balanced metadata access.

gfm_hosts.description: List of GFM servers to contact for metadata operations.

pool.description: Connection pool settings for backend storage.

max_connections.description: Max simultaneous connections in the pool.

connect_timeout.description: Seconds to wait when establishing a new connection.

idle_timeout.description: Seconds before an idle connection is closed.

storage.description: Metadata storage configuration (database backend and credentials).

auth_method.description: Authentication method: KERBEROS, GSI, PASSWORD, or NONE.

kerberos_keytab.description: Path to Kerberos keytab (required if auth_method=KERBEROS).

gsi_proxy_cert.description: Path to GSI proxy certificate (required if auth_method=GSI).

enable_client_cert_verify.description: Verify client certificates for GSI authentication.

limits.description: Resource and behavior limits for client sessions.

max_open_files.description: Maximum files a user may have open concurrently.

idle_timeout.description: Seconds before closing idle client connections.

default_replication_factor.description: Default number of file copies to create.

enable_lazy_replication.description: Delay replication until first read (write once, sync later).

lazy_replication_delay.description: Seconds to wait before triggering lazy replication.

items.description: Replica placement policy name (e.g., leastloaded, random, roundrobin).

quota.description: User and project quota enforcement settings.

enable_quotas.description: Enable enforcement of storage quotas per user/project.

backend.description: Quota backend: sqlite, mysql, or postgresql.

sqlite_db.description: SQLite database file path (used only if backend=sqlite).

mysql_database.description: MySQL database name (used only if backend=mysql).

postgresql_database.description: PostgreSQL database name (used only if backend=postgresql).
